objectives: Explain how and why the blessing passed to Jacob.
Describe the blessing of Jacob and the portion of Esau.
Explain why Esau found no place of repentance.
takeaways: The Lord allowed Isaac's blindness so the blessing could pass to Jacob; Rebekah carried the word that the elder shall serve the younger.
The blessing is rulership: let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee; be lord over thy brethren.
Esau found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears (Hebrews 12:16-17).
By thy sword shalt thou live: Esau has the dominion now, and when his rule is done, Jacob comes into power.
Esau hated Jacob for the blessing, as Cain hated Abel; good against evil runs from the beginning of the book to the end.
